messages:
Anna Li: Quick ask — onboarding sample app keeps showing a generic 500 error in the Go SDK instead of a typed ServerError. Are we standardizing HTTP->exception mapping across all SDKs?

Samir Patel: Not yet fully. Python maps 429 -> RateLimitError and includes retry_after. Go currently surfaces a generic Error with status 429. This causes onboarding confusion.

Vikram Rao: Proposal for parity: map 401/403 -> AuthError / PermissionDenied, 429 -> RateLimitError (include retry_after and mark as retryable), 408/499 -> ClientTimeout, 500/502/503 -> ServerError (non-retryable unless Retry-After header exists).

Lucy Chen: +1. Also we should standardize the user-facing message copy. Avoid internal terms like "auth token invalid" — prefer "Authentication failed — check your API key or refresh token." Small UX details matter in sample apps.

Anna Li: Suggested error JSON shape (for SDK responses and HTTP body):
```json
{
  "error_type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Request rate exceeded",
  "retry_after": "2",
  "details": null
}
```
Samir Patel: I like explicit "error_type" + numeric "status". Also add optional "guid" for correlation when reporting to support.

Vikram Rao: agreed. SDKs should map by "error_type" to typed exceptions so client code can do: 
```python
try:
  client.generate(...)
except RateLimitError as e:
  sleep(float(e.retry_after))
```
and similarly idiomatic patterns in Go/JS.

Lucy Chen: For streaming responses we should include the same error shape in a final error frame, and ensure sample apps show how to surface partial results + final error.

Anna Li: Who can own the Go mapping change? I want it in before tomorrow's onboarding demo.

Samir Patel: I'll take it. Creating PR now, adding unit tests + migration note for users relying on numeric status only. Branch: samir/typed-error-mapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/123

ci-bot: Build passed for samir/typed-error-mapping — tests green :white_check_mark:

Vikram Rao: Awesome. Lucy, can you update the sample app snippets to show catching typed errors and reading retry_after?

Lucy Chen: On it. I'll also draft user-facing phrasing examples in docs so copy is consistent. Small note: instead of "Please try again later" use "Retry after X seconds or contact support with this error id."

Anna Li: Approved. Quick changelog entry idea: "SDK error parity: map HTTP status + error_type, include retry_hint/retry_after, and provide typed exceptions in SDKs." @Samir please link the PR to the docs page.

Samir Patel: Done — PR now links to docs update in the repo and I added a migration note for users checking only status codes.

Lucy Chen: :thumbsup: let's ship
